candidates.text: This video is brought to you by milk focus fuel. Milk has 13 essential nutrients... the nutrients in milk help you lock in focus. Okay you know what, let's just try that again... just drink some milk, focus and lock in... We did it, good job Mr. Greg.
reasons: MILK MOMENT: the creator delivers the milk facts in his own words, then the take falls apart into bloopers and a retake that lands - organic, funny, positive

closes on 'We did it' - a real ending, not a mid-topic cut
